summary: Market reports use singular-aware evidence wording, quoted skipped terms, generic empty-store guidance, and advice to reuse another complete review-bearing snapshot. Empty-store hints use the JSON-safe quoted SEARCH TERM placeholder; trend sides are separated by semicolons.
reason: These Etsy-specific hand-written market reports must preserve sample limits and latest-snapshot selection while avoiding unnecessary paid review collection when local review data already exists. Review availability includes completed zero-review fetches and persisted review rows; only other complete snapshots qualify. Alternative advice now requires exact case-sensitive term coverage: all selected terms for top-level demand and price, and the individual term for demand rows. The newest eligible complete snapshot wins; price retains its correlation warning prefix.
